new_today_news.headline: WEF Purchases First U.S. Watershed-Based Carbon Offset Credits; Names Madison Metropolitan Sewerage District Official Carbon Offset Partner of WEFTEC 2026
new_today_news.summary: WEF announces purchase of watershed-based carbon offset credits and designates Madison Metropolitan Sewerage District as official carbon partner for WEFTEC 2026 conference scheduled for September in New Orleans.

new_today_news.headline: Renewable Fuel from Food Waste: Darling Ingredients
new_today_news.summary: Interview segment featuring Darling Ingredients' executive VP and CFO Bob Day discussing how the company converts food waste and animal byproducts into renewable fuel, collagen, and other value-added products. Darling Ingredients positions itself as a leader in circular economy and waste valorization.

new_today_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Highlights Growth in Renewable Fuels and Collagen
new_today_news.summary: At its May 11, 2026 Investor Day, Darling Ingredients highlighted Diamond Green Diesel's 1.2 billion gallons of renewable diesel capacity and early SAF adoption, supported by favorable U.S. renewable fuel mandates. The company emphasized rendering, collagen, and renewable fuels as core growth drivers.
